summary: Tested 3 new GDPR compliance features (firma legale documenti + notify MAJOR + area 'I miei dati'). Backend: 12/12 pytest passing after fixing 1 critical tz-aware/naive datetime comparison bug in /api/legal/decline/{token}. Frontend: verified /paziente/privacy, /terapeuta/privacy, /terapeuta/firma-documenti, sidebar 'I miei dati' item, /legal-decline/:token public page (invalid token).

minor.issue: audit_consents loop is dead code (no user_id filter, immediately 'pass') — cookie consents never exported. Not a blocker but incomplete.

storage_path can be null when Object Storage upload silently fails, and the receipt is then permanently 410 (PDF not stored in DB fallback despite comment mentioning base64 fallback). Verify EMERGENT_LLM_KEY / object storage config.

issues: 'Documenti firmati' section is hidden when user has zero signatures — spec expected 4 sections always visible; consider showing empty state instead.

action_items: [DONE by testing agent] Fixed tz-aware vs naive datetime comparison in legal_signature.py::legal_decline — Mongo returned naive datetime causing 500.

Review Object Storage upload path for signature receipts: silent failure leaves storage_path=null and receipt endpoint returns 410 forever. Either implement inline DB fallback (as comment suggests) or bubble the error.
In gdpr_export, either remove dead audit_consents loop or filter by user email/id and return the aggregated consents.
critical_code_review_comments: legal_signature.py:390 (fixed): comparing tz-aware datetime.now(utc) with naive Mongo datetime raised TypeError → 500 on any /legal/decline call. Added normalization.
legal_signature.py sign(): PDF hash and receipt_id are generated but storage_path may be None; downstream download returns 410. Comment says base64 DB fallback but it is not implemented.
legal_signature.py:180 stores raw IP (ip_raw) even though _anonymize_ip is also stored. Retention comment says '10 years' — verify with DPO whether raw IP retention is GDPR-defensible.

legal_signature.py notify_major_update() emits emails inside the loop synchronously (`await`) — if RESEND_API_KEY is unset it silently returns and only logs. Consider batching / rate limiting for large user bases.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke of the 3 pages + sidebar + decline

seed_data_creation: Deleted terapeuta contract_acceptances before each sign-related test. Created a v-next MAJOR version of contratto_collaborazione (kind unchanged). Left the therapist re-activated at end. Added marketing consent grant/revoke history for paziente demo (visible in UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16_gdpr_signature.py uses cookies via requests.Session and directly manipulates db.contract_acceptances between tests. If contratto_collaborazione has been bumped to v>=3, therapist pending count may still be 4 iff no acceptance for current version exists — the fixture resets it. Object Storage may still return storage_path=None if Emergent Object Storage backend not fully configured; owner-download test tolerates both 200 and 410.
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/legal/decline/{valid_token} returned 500 because tokens created via db.legal_decline_tokens.insert_one() were stored with tz-aware datetime, but Motor/Mongo returns them tz-naive on read. Comparing exp < datetime.now(timezone.utc) raised TypeError. Fix normalizes exp to UTC-aware before comparison.
